integrity: All numerical checks described here were actually executed; no independent mathematical audit or independent priority certification has been performed.
limitations: The EGF is proved for induced maximum degree at most two; it is not the induced-forest polynomial.
The total outer domination complement result is limited to m,n>=2 and max(m,n)>=5.
The 2024 k-independence Cartesian-products paper was available for abstract-level comparison only; publication priority remains uncertain.
title: Three-independent rook-graph polynomials and bipartite two-factor extremizers
